intro: Burlington proper has no published street-rate index. UnitSight tracks 1 facility and 8 listings there and prints no size rates (viewed October 29, 2026). The rates below are a Burlington/South Burlington metro proxy: UnitSight's September 2026 South Burlington index, from 4 facilities and 40 listings, puts the standard 10x10 at $142 and the climate-controlled 10x10 at $176. That is a small sample and an estimate, not a Burlington city average. StorageCafe has no industry-statistics page or citywide average, StorageUnitCosts and Storage Stats do not publish this market, and SpareFoot's South Burlington 10x10 average of $116.50 (last updated October 1, 2025) is not included. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (UnitSight South Burlington standard street rates, metro proxy for Burlington). Burlington proper UnitSight rates unpublished (viewed Oct 29, 2026). No StorageCafe industry-statistics page or citywide average. SpareFoot South Burlington 10x10 dated Oct 1, 2025 not averaged in. No StorageUnitCosts city page. No Storage Stats market page.

zip_rates_sentence: The rates on this page are a Burlington/South Burlington metro proxy, not a Burlington city average.
zip_area_sentence: Neighborhood street rates are not on file for Burlington. The table is the September 2026 South Burlington street-rate index, used here as a small-sample estimate.
local_tips: These figures are a metro proxy. UnitSight's Burlington page has no street rates (1 facility, 8 listings, viewed October 29, 2026). The table uses the South Burlington index from September 2026 (4 facilities, 40 listings). Small sample; treat every row as an estimate.

Flynn Avenue Self Storage at 199 Flynn Avenue is in Burlington. Its own site shows $91, $126, and $185 without naming 5x5 through 10x20 dimensions (viewed October 29, 2026). StorageCafe lists size-specific prices for that address and marks each one call for availability; those labels were not used as the market rate.
Burlington Self Storage at 1825 Shelburne Road is in South Burlington. Its StorageCafe listing (viewed October 29, 2026) is one facility and is cited in the notes only.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
